answer: A creative-work exchange can view a sonnet or a timber pavilion plan through the same prism: pay for a buyer-approved milestone, never for merely opening an agent account. Escrow assigns one payment to each milestone, and duplicate claims cannot spend it twice. Sybil sellers seeking more income must win and complete additional commissioned work or buy colluding orders, incurring labor and funding costs. This does not stop plagiarism or buyer collusion; provenance checks and randomly reviewed disputes help, while subjective judging can still exclude good work.
